final: WITH step1 AS (SELECT ds.raceId, c.country, AVG(ds.wins) as avg_wins FROM driverStandings ds JOIN races r ON ds.raceId = r.raceId JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId GROUP BY ds.raceId, c.country), step2 AS (SELECT country, AVG(avg_wins) as avg_avg_wins FROM step1 GROUP BY country), step3 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_avg_wins) as overall_avg FROM step2), step4 AS (SELECT step2.country, step2.avg_avg_wins, step2.avg_avg_wins - step3.overall_avg as diff FROM step2, step3 WHERE step2.avg_avg_wins > step3.overall_avg), step5 AS (SELECT AVG(avg_avg_wins) as avg_of_above_overall FROM step4) SELECT step4.country, step4.avg_avg_wins, step4.diff, step4.avg_avg_wins - step5.avg_of_above_overall as final_diff FROM step4, step5 WHERE step4.avg_avg_wins > step5.avg_of_above_overall
